definition: Ikintu gifite ubuzima. Ikizima kigira ibiranga ubuzima byose bitandatu: kigizwe n'ingirabuzimafatizo, gishobora kororoka, gifata kandi gisohora ibintu, gikeneye imbaraga, kandi gisubiza uko bimeze bitewe n'ibikikije.
Agace gato kurusha ayandi gafite ubuzima. Ibizima byose bigizwe n'ingirabuzimafatizo. Nyinshi muri zo ni nto cyane ku buryo hakenewe mikorosikopi kugira ngo zibonwe.
Ikizima kigizwe n'ingirabuzimafatizo imwe gusa, urugero nka bagiteri cyangwa parameshiyumu. Iyo ngirabuzimafatizo imwe igomba kwikorera ibintu byose – gushaka ibiribwa, kwirwanaho no kororoka.
Ikizima kigizwe n'ingirabuzimafatizo nyinshi zikorana. Buri ngirabuzimafatizo ifite akazi kayo bwite, urugero nk'iz'imitsi (misuli) n'izifasha kohereza ubutumwa mu mubiri (nerve cells).

Igihe ingirabuzimafatizo igabanyijemo ikagira ebyiri. Uko ni ko ibizima bifite ingirabuzimafatizo nyinshi bikura kandi bigasimbuza izapfuye, kandi ni na ko ibizima bifite ingirabuzimafatizo imwe byororoka.
Ingirabuzimafatizo nyinshi zisa kandi zifite akazi kamwe, zikagira agace kamwe hamwe, urugero nk'ingirangingo z'imitsi (muscle tissue) cyangwa iz'imitsi y'ubwonko (nervous tissue).
Igice cy'umubiri kigizwe n'ingirangingo zitandukanye kandi gifite akazi kagenwe. Umutima, ibihaha, umwijima n'impyiko ni ingero z'ingingo.
Igikonjo cyo hanze cy'ingirabuzimafatizo. Gifata ingirabuzimafatizo hamwe kandi gikora nk'umuringa ugena ibintu bishobora kwinjira no gusohoka muri yo. Iboneka muri buri ngirabuzimafatizo.

Ikigo kigenga ingirabuzimafatizo. Intangangingo igenga ingirabuzimafatizo kandi irimo ibirimo iremwa (ADN), aricyo gishushanyo cy'ibintu byose ingirabuzimafatizo ikora. Iboneka mu ngirabuzimafatizo z'inyamaswa n'iz'ibimera ariko ntiboneke muri bagiteri.
Amazi asa n'ubuki ari imbere mu ngirabuzimafatizo, hagati y'uruhu rwayo, aho hari uduce tw'imirimo (organelles).
Isoko y'imbaraga y'ingirabuzimafatizo. Muri mitokondiriya harekurwa imbaraga ingirabuzimafatizo ikeneye kugira ngo ibeho kandi ikore. Iboneka mu ngirabuzimafatizo z'inyamaswa n'iz'ibimera.
Uruganda rukora poroteyine mu ngirabuzimafatizo. Ribozomu zubaka poroteyine, ibintu bikora akazi kenshi mu mubiri.

Igikonjo gikomeye kiri hanze y'uruhu rw'ingirabuzimafatizo, gitanga ishusho ihamye kandi ifite impande, hamwe n'ubushobozi. Iboneka mu ngirabuzimafatizo z'ibimera (na bagiteri) ariko ntiboneke mu ngirabuzimafatizo z'inyamaswa.
Uduce twicyatsi two mu ngirabuzimafatizo z'ibimera aho fotosintezi ikorerwa. Korloplasite ifata imbaraga z'urumuri rw'izuba. Ingirabuzimafatizo z'inyamaswa nta korloplasite zifite.
Akatura kuzuye amazi imbere mu ngirabuzimafatizo. Mu ngirabuzimafatizo z'ibimera, vakuwole akenshi iba nini kandi iri hagati; ibika ibintu kandi igatuma ingirabuzimafatizo ikomera.

Igikorwa gikorerwa muri korloplasite z'ibimera, aho imbaraga z'urumuri rw'izuba zifatwa zigakoreshwa mu kubaka ibintu birimo imbaraga nyinshi. Inyamaswa ntizishobora gukoresha urumuri nk'isoko y'imbaraga.
Iremwa riri mu ntangangingo y'ingirabuzimafatizo. ADN ni ishusho igena ibiranga ingirabuzimafatizo n'ikizima cyayo. Uzongera kubona ADN mu gice cy'iremwa (Genetike).
Ikizima gifite ingirabuzimafatizo imwe, gito cyane ugereranyije n'ingirabuzimafatizo zacu, kandi kidafite intangangingo. Bagiteri nyinshi ni ingirakamaro mu kubora ibintu; izindi zitera indwara.

Igitera indwara kitagizwe n'ingirabuzimafatizo kandi mu bisanzwe kitabarwa nk'ikizima. Virusi ni igikonjo kirimo iremwa kigomba gufata ingirabuzimafatizo ifite ubuzima kugira ngo yororoke. Antibiyotike ntizigira icyo zimarira ku virusi.
Ibizima, urugero nka bagiteri n'ibihumyo, bibora ibimera n'inyamaswa byapfuye bikabihindura intungamubiri zigira ubutaka bushya.

Imiti, urugero nka penisiline, yica bagiteri cyangwa igabanya ukwiyongera kwazo. Antibiyotike ikora gusa kuri bagiteri – ntikore ku birusi. Igomba gukoreshwa mu buryo bwitonze kugira ngo hatabaho bagiteri zitayigenderaho.
Itsinda ry'ibizima bishobora kubyarana mu buryo busanzwe bigatanga urubyaro rushobora na rwo kubyara — abana bashobora kongera kubyara abandi. Umuntu ni ubwoko (Homo sapiens).
Ivanzwe hagati y'amoko abiri atandukanye, urugero nk'inyumbu (ifarashi × indogobe). Ivanze akenshi ntashobora kubyara kandi ku bw'ibyo ntibishobora kubyara ubwabyo.
Icyiciro kinini cy'ibizima byose. Domaine eshatu ni bagiteri nyakuri, arukeya (archaea), n'ibizima bifite intangangingo (ibimera, ibihumyo n'inyamaswa).
